   - Delete keys from checkpoint data
   - Corrupt tensor values
   - Truncate saved files
   - Add artificial delays

The fix was simply to restore the original file using `git checkout fvcore/common/checkpoint.py`. All 8 checkpoint tests now pass successfully.
